title: Send-only and receive-only
hints: chan<- T can only be sent to. <-chan T can only be received from. The arrow shows which way the data flows relative to chan.
Ping only sends on pings, so pings should be chan<- string. Pong receives from pings and sends on pongs.
func Ping(pings chan<- string, msg string) and func Pong(pings <-chan string, pongs chan<- string)
